title: Ticker Go - Project Support
description: Add project filtering and budget tracking to ticker Go program. Depends on ticks CLI having project field support.
notes: 2026-01-14 20:42 - Completed task i6d: Added --project flag to ticker run. Key changes: (1) Added Project field to Epic/Task types in types.go, (2) Added ListReadyEpicsWithProject method in client.go with fallback for older tk versions, (3) Updated autoSelectEpics and runPicker to filter by project, (4) Added warning when explicit epic ID doesn't match --project. The flag passes project to tk list --project and also filters locally as fallback.
